images.alt:
The image underneath is a snapshot of the radar from 8:00am this morning (7th July 2026). The O's and X's indicate where lightning has struck. Blue and yellow represent precipitation signals which are shown over Nelson, Marlborough and Canterbury. 

In the last 12 hours (8:00pm Monday – 8:00am Tuesday):
Picton has measured ~105mm
The Kaikōura Ranges have measured ~110mm
The Waimakariri District has measured ~80mm
Ashburton has measured ~60mm

A few reminders:
These warnings are still in place for a reason.
Continue to follow advice from Emergency Management and your local council.
Look after yourselves and one another

post.text: Overnight heavy rain has affected parts of the South Island. The image underneath is a snapshot of the radar from 8:00am this morning (7th July 2026). The O's and X's indicate where lightning has struck.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
